_note: Initial state for --init. Camera frame of the tracker (x right, y down, z forward, metres); 'state51' = [transl(3), global_orient(3) axis-angle, hand_pose(45) axis-angle relative to MANO hands_mean] (smplx MANO, flat_hand_mean=False). Alternatively give MANO keys instead of state51: transl, global_orient, hand_pose and flat_hand_mean (true if hand_pose is the full pose). betas optional (10).
